## Contribution Type
- [ ] New Test Case (`cases/` or `custom_cases/`)
- [ ] Model Benchmark Scorecard (`reports/`)
- [ ] Core Engine / Runner Improvement
- [ ] Documentation

## For New Test Cases:
- [ ] Zero external dependencies (uses standard library only)
- [ ] Validated locally using `python -m lowend_bench validate`
- [ ] Tested against at least one local or mock endpoint

## For Scorecard Submissions:
- [ ] Generated using `python -m lowend_bench submit ...`
- [ ] Model identifier and hardware specifications specified
- [ ] No private paths, usernames, or secrets in report
